decisions.reason: As a flagship service very close to the core vessel-management business, offshore management still looks like a valuable strategic option and is more likely to be retained or absorbed into the main offer than abandoned outright.
Crew and corporate travel management extends an existing capability and can be maintained at relatively low cost for current maritime clients, even if demand conditions have recently been volatile.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital extension that supports customer proximity and broader service coverage, so management would keep this option open unless results clearly turned poor.

The mobile vessel performance app is a more peripheral and potentially overlapping digital option, and with several adjacent offerings already in place management would likely reallocate resources if traction has not become clear by now.
